FULL TEXT:

NOTIFICATION
PUBLICATION OF PROVISIONAL PANEL AND WAITING LIST OF 1ST STATE LEVEL SELECTION
TEST-2016 (EXCEPT HILL REGION)
FOR RECRUITMENT OF ASSISTANT TEACHERS-2016 FOR UPPER PRIMARY LEVEL CLASSES
IN STATE GOVT. AIDED/SPONSORED SCHOOLS (EXCEPT WORK EDUCATION & PHYSICAL
EDUCATION) (EXCLUDING PARA-TEACHERS)
Memo. No.890/6723(IV)/CSSC/ESTT/2023 Dated: 23.08.2023
In compliance of the solemn order dated 16.08.2023 passed by the Hon’ble High Court, Calcutta in
relation to the M.A.T No. 638 of 2021, C.A.N. NO. 1 of 2021 in W.P.No.11162 of 2021 Rajib Bramha &
Ors. vs. The State of West Bengal & Ors, the provisional panel and provisional waiting list in r/o 1ST
SLST, 2016 for recruitment of Assistant Teachers (Upper Primary) as mentioned above in State Govt.
aided/sponsored Schools (Except Hill Region) is hereby published today, the 23rd August, 2023.
Candidates may find their status in the panel and waiting list under reference in the website of
Commission i.e. www. westbengalssc.com and www.wbsschelpdesk.com.
Sd/-
Secretary
West Bengal Central School Service Commission
The West Bengal Central School Service Commission
ACHARYA SADAN: 11 & 11/1, Block-EE, Salt Lake; Kolkata-700091
